note: Color API is configured via colorapi.settings with two switches: enable_color_field (default true) and enable_color_entity (default false), at /admin/config/color/settings (route colorapi.admin_config, permission 'administer colors'). It provides the colorapi_color_field field type (columns name varchar255 + color varchar7; formatters colorapi_color_display[default]/colorapi_text_display/colorapi_raw_hex_display/colorapi_raw_rgb_display; widget colorapi_color_widget), the colorapi.service (hexToRgb, isValidHexadecimalColorString, regex /^#([A-Fa-f0-9]{6}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{3})$/), Typed Data types colorapi_color/hexadecimal_color/rgb_color, and (when enabled) a colorapi_color config entity (config name colorapi.colorapi_color.<id>, keys id/label/color). Medium/hard cases are grounded in that live config: reading enable_color_entity, finding a colorapi_color_field field, creating a Color field, and creating a named Color entity. Site artifacts are namespaced field_cai_* and cai_* ids; scripts restore baseline (enable_color_entity=false, no cai_* config/fields).

evals.prompt: The colorapi (Color API) module is enabled on a Drupal 11 site. What are its two configuration switches, what do they turn on, and where is the settings page?
evals.expected_output: colorapi.settings has enable_color_field (default true; enables the colorapi_color_field field type) and enable_color_entity (default false; enables the colorapi_color config entity). Configure at /admin/config/color/settings (permission 'administer colors').

evals.prompt: With Color API, what is the machine name of the color field type it provides, and which display formatters can I use to render it?
evals.expected_output: Field type colorapi_color_field. Formatters: colorapi_color_display (colored block, default), colorapi_text_display, colorapi_raw_hex_display, colorapi_raw_rgb_display (with display_name / show_hash settings).

evals.prompt: How can I convert a hexadecimal color like #3366cc into its red/green/blue components using Color API's service, and how does it validate that a string is a hex color?
evals.expected_output: Call \Drupal::service('colorapi.service')->hexToRgb($hex, 'red'|'green'|'blue') for each component; isValidHexadecimalColorString() validates against /^#([A-Fa-f0-9]{6}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{3})$/.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Color API configuration and state whether the optional Color configuration entity type is enabled, and which colorapi.settings key controls that.
evals.expected_output: The Color entity is enabled: colorapi.settings.enable_color_entity is true (1) — the switch that registers the colorapi_color config entity type.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a Color API color field attached. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of the field whose type is colorapi_color_field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_cai_swatch: its field storage type is colorapi_color_field on node.article.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Color API color field named field_cai_color (type colorapi_color_field) to the Article content type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A field storage node.field_cai_color of type colorapi_color_field exists and is attached to the Article bundle (field.field.node.article.field_cai_color).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use Color API to create a reusable named Color: enable the Color configuration entity type if needed, then create a Color entity with id cai_red, label 'CAI Red' and color #FF0000. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Config colorapi.colorapi_color.cai_red exists with color '#FF0000' (label 'CAI Red'). This requires enable_color_entity=true so the colorapi_color entity type is registered, then Color::create(['id'=>'cai_red','label'=>'CAI Red','color'=>'#FF0000'])->save().
